Software Requirements Specification for TaskManager Pro

1. Introduction
TaskManager Pro is a web-based task management application for small teams.

2. Functional Requirements
FR-01: The system shall allow users to create tasks with a title, description, due date, and priority level (low, medium, high).
FR-02: The system shall allow users to assign tasks to team members.
FR-03: The system shall send email notifications when a task is assigned or when a due date is within 24 hours.
FR-04: The system shall allow users to filter tasks by status (todo, in-progress, done) and priority.
FR-05: The system shall provide a dashboard showing task completion statistics for the current week.

3. Non-Functional Requirements
NFR-01: The system shall respond to API requests within 500ms under normal load.
NFR-02: The system shall support up to 100 concurrent users.
NFR-03: The system shall be available 99.9% of the time.
NFR-04: User passwords shall be stored using bcrypt hashing.
NFR-05: The system shall comply with GDPR data protection requirements.
